_about: Plant-confirmed settings for the CCR Kiln-3 advisor. null = keep the current default (see plant_settings.README.md for each key's question number and default). Restart the backend after editing process / bands / state_rules / interlocks / quality; fuels, optimizer and advisor are re-read on every run.

guardrails._about: GR4 operating parameters: hard roof / floor per advisor parameter (CCR operators via project lead 2026-10-21; temp floor 850->820 on 2026-10-23). Checked on the live value and the recommended value (temp: the predicted T+10). A value exactly AT a limit is allowed. null = no limit. Re-read on every request.

combustion._about: GR1: LIVE CO / O2 (2-min average, analyser purge excluded) against the interlock limits; while one is outside, no Accept may add fuel. 'limits' overrides an interlock for GR1 only. Kiln inlet CO 1500 confirmed by the plant 2026-10-27 (Q4.3; now also in interlocks).

direction._about: GR2 (CAUTION, amber, does not block Accept since 2026-10-29): forecast T+10 temp with the move more than margin_c above the band and the move adds total calciner heat by more than min_heat_change_pct (or below and it cuts heat). Smaller changes are noise / grid rounding. Drift (GR6), uncertainty (GR7) and heat change (GR8) are cautions too; limits, live CO/O2 and data checks stay red and block.

doc._about: GR3: latest fresh hot meal DOC (eLIMS result < 4 h old) below min = under-calcining -> the advisor will not cut total calciner heat; above max = over-calcining -> it will not raise heat. 92-96 % = plant questionnaire 2026-10-27 (was 94.0 project lead placeholder).

drift._about: GR6: T+10 forecasts checked by the shadow runner over the last window_min (kiln running, at least min_points checks). Mean abs error above max_mae_c or mean bias beyond max_abs_bias_c -> model drifting, amber caution (does not block Accept since 2026-10-29). Test MAE 6.9, persistence 9.1 (2026-10-26); tune once more live checks exist.

uncertainty._about: GR7: P10-P90 of the predicted T+10 temperature under the recommendation wider than max_width_c, or P90 above / P10 below the temperature roof / floor above -> amber caution (does not block Accept since 2026-10-29). Seen so far: median 24, max 33 degC (25 live points, 2026-10-26).

_plant_inputs: Values below marked 2026-10-27 come from the plant questionnaire docs/CCR_Kiln3_Advisor_Plant_Inputs_Required.xlsx (filled 27 Oct 2026; sign-off pending).

process._about: clinker_factor = clinker t per kiln feed t. Plant 2026-10-29: feed-to-clinker factor 1.7 -> 1/1.7 = 0.588 (was 0.62).

temperature_bands._about: Plant 2026-10-27 (Q1.2): 15 degC less for each state than the former 920-940 / 900-920 / 880-900.

state_weights._about: Plant 2026-10-27 (Q1.3): weight of each lab / PLC vote in the operating-state decision (weighted mean of the State 1/2/3 votes, rounded).

quality._about: GR5 clinker quality (free lime / liter weight zone) + lab warnings. Plant 2026-10-27 (Q4.6-4.9). Hot meal SO3 / Cl max are shown as lab warnings.

fuels._about: Plant 2026-10-27 (Q2.3, 3.3, 2.4/3.4, 4.11): coal is a mix (Indian coal ~4000 + pet coke ~8000), range 5000-6500 -> midpoint 5750; SAFR 2200-2500 -> 2350. Cost is not considered (prices unused; objective = least coal). LAFR is ignored: left out of total heat and TSR.

heat_split._about: Plant 2026-10-29 (60/40), changed 2026-11-18 to SAFR 15 %, coal 85 %: when total calciner heat goes UP, the extra heat (kcal) comes this share from each lever. The lever with the bigger share goes first; if it is at its limit or step cap (coal +-5 %), the other takes the rest. Heat CUTS are not split (coal first, as before). Remove or set null to switch off.

process_response._about: Calciner outlet temp change (C) per unit lever change, at 5/10/15/30 min. null = measured default (twin/model.py RESPONSE_DEFAULTS).
